title: Guessed-next-vertex register value
statement: For a program register state with guessed-next-vertex value $nx$, the value of its register-value vector at index $8$ is $nx$.
replaced:
Let a register state have ordered values $(p,n,a,b,s,t,tmp,st,nx)$ in registers $0$
through $8$. Its register-$8$ value is $nx$.
